d:
A clown-inspired humanoid species wearing a ruffled collar of ivory white and a top hat of charcoal black. The face is painted with theatrical patterns and framed by wild, spiked hair of electric yellow. A lean build is draped in a tuxedo of alternating magenta and royal purple stripes with a yellow bowtie. The creature has a long, thin tail ending in a small spade. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale white
